_doc: EEGDex manifest — NEW node (Muse EEG), per SIGNAL-ADAPTER brief Phase 3 (manifest-as-single-source). Carries the Phase-3 additions `evidence` (5-level ladder) + `goodDirection` per metric so codegen/dex-registry-gen.js projects eegdex-registry.js from ONE source. EEG is a genuinely new signal type — the adapter layer standardizes its INGEST; this manifest is the metric/grade source, not the DSP. Maturity is stated as dated prose in `warning` (rendered), never as a status enum — the `status` field was retired 2026-09-20.
description: Band-power and sleep-architecture analysis from consumer EEG (Muse). Direct spectral readouts, EEG-staged hypnogram, and derived micro-architecture markers.
warning: EEGDex is a scaffold, not a shipped node — as of 2026-09-20 a DSP module and its selftest exist, but no EEGDex app, bundle or hand-authored registry is built, and the adapter layer routes EEG files to an EEGDSP that resolves to undefined in every shipped bundle. This guide documents the manifest's intended metrics, not measured behaviour. Consumer dry-electrode EEG (4-channel Muse) has higher artifact rates and lower spatial resolution than clinical PSG. Contact quality gates every downstream metric.

fields.eeg: Float32Array[ch] — µV, 256 Hz, 4 channels (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10)
fields.timestamps: Float64Array — floating wall-clock ms per sample (Clock Contract)

sections.title: Signal & Contact
sections.description: Direct signal-quality readouts that gate everything downstream

metrics.name: Contact Quality
metrics.fullName: Fraction of the recording with all electrodes in good contact
metrics.formula: mean(all-channel contact ≥ threshold)
metrics.cite: Per-channel contact quality — direct sensor readout

metrics.name: Analyzable
metrics.fullName: Fraction of the recording usable after artifact rejection
metrics.formula: 1 − artifactRejectedFraction
metrics.cite: Analyzable coverage after artifact rejection — direct

metrics.name: Total Spectral Power
metrics.fullName: Broadband EEG power over (0, 45] Hz, the band the transform sums
metrics.formula: Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Broadband spectral power — direct from the PSD. The amplitude unit is the EDF channel's own physical dimension, which the DSP carries as `unit` and the surface prints; this node never assumes µV, so the registry states a squared amplitude rather than µV²

sections.title: Band Powers
sections.description: Relative power in the canonical EEG bands

metrics.name: Relative Delta
metrics.fullName: Delta-band ([0.5, 4) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([0.5, 4) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative delta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Theta
metrics.fullName: Theta-band ([4, 8) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([4, 8) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative theta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Alpha
metrics.fullName: Alpha-band ([8, 12) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([8, 12) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative alpha power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Sigma
metrics.fullName: Sigma-band ([12, 16) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([12, 16) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative sigma power — established EEG band readout, a band share and never a spindle count

metrics.name: Relative Beta
metrics.fullName: Beta-band ([16, 30) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([16, 30) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative beta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Alpha/Theta Ratio
metrics.fullName: Ratio of alpha to theta band power
metrics.formula: median over epochs with nonzero theta power of P([8, 12) Hz) / P([4, 8) Hz)
metrics.cite: Alpha/theta ratio — published drowsiness/relaxation index, device-dependent

metrics.name: Spectral Edge 95 %
metrics.fullName: Frequency below which 95 % of the epoch's examined power sits
metrics.formula: median over epochs of min{ f : Σ P(≤ f) ≥ 0.95 × Σ P over (0, 45] Hz }
metrics.cite: Spectral edge frequency — a definition over the same PSD the band shares divide, with no tuned constant and no stage assumption. The 45 Hz ceiling is this engine's own, so the answer is an edge of the EXAMINED band and never of the channel

metrics.name: REM Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored REM from EEG
metrics.formula: remEpochs / totalSleepEpochs
metrics.cite: REM fraction from the staged hypnogram — it inherits the single-channel stager's tier, never the reference standard's. PSG EEG staging is the reference standard; this stager is not PSG-validated

metrics.name: Spindle Density
metrics.fullName: Sleep-spindle count per minute of staged N2 and N3
metrics.formula: detections / staged NREM minutes, over an epoch-relative sigma envelope
metrics.cite: Sleep-spindle density (11–16 Hz bursts) — published memory-consolidation marker. The DETECTOR is a relative-envelope rule this suite wrote, and no expert-scored spindle has judged it, so the metric carries the suite's own tier and never the marker's. It dropped from `emerging` to `heuristic` when it stopped being a refusal

metrics.name: Frontal Alpha Asymmetry
metrics.fullName: ln(α right) − ln(α left) over frontal channels (AF7/AF8)
metrics.formula: ln(αAF8) − ln(αAF7)
metrics.cite: Frontal alpha asymmetry — affective-state composite, EEGDex-derived, weak consumer-grade support

metrics.name: Calm Score
metrics.fullName: Composite relaxation index blended from band ratios
metrics.formula: weighted blend of α/θ, β suppression, and stability
metrics.cite: Calm score — heuristic wellness composite, not a validated EEG metric

metrics.name: Hypnogram
metrics.fullName: Per-epoch sleep-stage series scored from one EEG channel
metrics.formula: stageEpoch(bands) per 30 s epoch, median-smoothed
metrics.cite: Single-channel band-power staging — literature-backed, not PSG-validated (EEGDEX-BUILD-BRIEF §0)

metrics.name: Formula Hypnogram
metrics.fullName: Per-epoch stage series from a fitted stage formula over the same EEG channel
metrics.formula: the 35 feature columns per 30 s epoch, evaluated by the coefficients of a reader-supplied model file
metrics.cite: A second stage source, off unless the reader turns it on. The coefficients were fitted on sleep-laboratory derivations and a small number of forehead recordings, and no blind read has judged this port's agreement with an expert score, so the series carries `experimental`, one rank above the lowest tier the ladder holds. It names four classes (wake, light, deep, REM) and not the band-power stager's five

metrics.name: Total Sleep Time
metrics.fullName: Hours of epochs scored N1, N2, N3 or REM
metrics.cite: Total sleep time from the staged hypnogram — it inherits the stager tier, never the clock tier

metrics.name: Sleep Efficiency
metrics.fullName: Percent of SCORED epochs that are sleep, not of the recording span
metrics.formula: 100 × sleepEpochs / scoredEpochs
metrics.cite: Sleep efficiency over the scored population — an unscorable epoch is excluded, never counted as wake

metrics.name: N3 Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored N3, the slow-wave share
metrics.formula: 100 × N3 / sleepEpochs
metrics.cite: N3 fraction from the staged hypnogram — single-channel stager, not a PSG score

metrics.name: N1 Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored N1, the lightest stage
metrics.formula: 100 × N1 / sleepEpochs
metrics.cite: N1 fraction from the staged hypnogram — the stage a band-power rule scores least reliably. Against the simulator's planted truth this engine over-reads N1, so the number carries the stager's tier and a stated shortfall

metrics.name: N2 Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored N2, the dominant NREM stage
metrics.formula: 100 × N2 / sleepEpochs
metrics.cite: N2 fraction from the staged hypnogram — single-channel stager, not a PSG score

metrics.name: Wake Fraction
metrics.fullName: Percent of SCORED epochs scored wake, not of the recording span
metrics.formula: 100 × W / scoredEpochs
metrics.cite: Wake fraction over the scored population — an unscorable epoch is excluded, never counted as wake. It is the complement of sleep efficiency over the same denominator

metrics.name: Sleep Latency
metrics.fullName: Minutes of elapsed epochs before the first epoch scored as sleep
metrics.formula: 0.5 × elapsed epochs before the first sleep epoch
metrics.cite: Sleep-onset latency from the staged hypnogram. It counts ELAPSED epochs, so an unscorable epoch before onset still costs the time it occupied — a latency is a clock fact rather than a scoring fact

metrics.name: REM Latency
metrics.fullName: Minutes from the first sleep epoch to the first epoch scored REM
metrics.formula: 0.5 × (first REM epoch − first sleep epoch)
metrics.cite: REM latency from the staged hypnogram — it inherits the stager's REM tier, and a night with no REM epoch reports the absence with its own reason

metrics.name: Wake After Sleep Onset
metrics.fullName: Minutes scored wake strictly between the first and last sleep epoch
metrics.formula: 0.5 × wake epochs between the first and last sleep epoch
metrics.cite: Wake after sleep onset from the staged hypnogram. The bounds are STRICT, so wake before onset and wake after the final sleep epoch are not WASO

metrics.name: Stage Shifts
metrics.fullName: Count of stage transitions over the scored series
metrics.formula: transitions over the scored series, where an unscorable epoch BREAKS the run
metrics.cite: Stage-shift count from the staged hypnogram. Measured against the simulator's planted truth this engine reports roughly twice the planted transitions, because an epoch-independent rule set fragments a stable stage, so the number reads this stager's fragmentation as much as the night's

metrics.name: REM Periods
metrics.fullName: Count of REM runs, merged across a non-REM gap of up to 5 minutes
metrics.formula: maximal REM runs merged across a gap of ≤ 10 epochs
metrics.cite: REM period count from the staged hypnogram. It is NOT the Feinberg–Floyd NREM–REM cycle, which needs an NREM duration rule this engine does not apply, and the name says so

metrics.name: Slow-Wave Activity Decline
metrics.fullName: Change in NREM delta power per NREM stretch, against the first stretch
metrics.formula: 100 × leastSquaresSlope(median delta power vs stretch index) / first stretch's median
metrics.cite: The overnight fall of slow-wave activity. What this metric measures is the SLOPE over NREM delta power, and it claims nothing about sleep homeostasis: that reading rests on a citation this repo has not verified, so the metric carries the suite's own tier
